segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Hello.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Urn my family and I are staying here in Trebirch for a week or two and we wanted to know about the train services.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: We're hoping to do a few 11ocal trips.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: OK.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: Well,' I can give you lots of details about all the trains going from Trebirch in the South West.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: This leaflet will be very helpful but I can tell you some of the main things.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: We've got two main train stations in the town.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: King Street is for local commuter lines and regional services.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: What about trains to London?

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: I'll need to go there on business for one day.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: Then you need to go to Central Station- that's for all the national services.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: There are regular trains to London.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: They leave Trebirch every half hour ~n weekdays and every hour at weekends.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: It takes about two hours, a bit longer on Sundays.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: You've got a choice of first and second class and there's a buffet car- though refreshments are included in the cost of a first class ticket.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Ah right.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Urn, and have you got any information on different ticket types?

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: Yes.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: There's a range of ticket prices depending on when you travel and when you buy your ticket.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: There's a standard open ticket which doesn't have any restrictions.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: This can be bought in advance or on the day.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: You can also get various discounted tickets.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: A popular one is called the Supersave and, er, this is OK for travel after 8.45.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: Then there is the Special ticket, which is valid for travel after .1Q..12.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: The Special tickets are also valid for travel at weekends.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: The cheapest tickets are called Advance and you have to buy them at least six days ahead.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: Only a certain number are available and you have to make seat reservations for these.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Thanks.

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: And are there lots of places to go to around here?

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: Oh yes.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: You can enjoy many days out.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: Urn there's the Merthyr Mining /19/20 Museum, which is only half an hour from Trebirch by train.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: Your children will find it just as fascinating as any theme park and they can ride in the original miners' lifts and on the coal trains.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: There are special excursion tickets which include entrance fees.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: Mainline trains also offer direct services to Bristol, where you can visit the docks or spend a /19/20 great day out with the children in the m.Q, which is set in the parkland that used to surround the old castle.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: Er, special family awayday fares are available for this service now during the school holidays.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: Er, alternatively, you can be in Birmingham in only an hour and a half, where there's lots to see and do including the new and internationally- acclaimed climbing wall built on the site of the old aquarium.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: We will /19120 also be running a special service to Newport when the new science museum opens next year, as we anticipate a lot of visitors in the opening weeks.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: I'd advise you to call early to book your tickets.

segments.speaker: RAILPERSON
segments.en: Is that OK?

segments.speaker: CUSTOMER
segments.en: Yes, thanks.
